changes: command-catalog-smoke.ts now branches its AGENT_DISPATCH_REGISTRY loop on AGENT_DISPATCH_ACCEPTED_TYPES membership: dispatchable entries are asserted schema-valid and runtime-valid; retired entries (lattice-review-channel) are asserted schema-rejected and runtime-rejected. lattice.config.json wires the smoke into validate.commands on the normal (non-fast) tier.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.js (exit 0). It also now runs automatically as one of the guard commands under lattice validate.
expectedOutcome: The smoke exits 0 printing 'command catalog smoke passed: <N> commands'; lattice validate executes it; any divergence between the dispatch agentType enum and the retired-agent registry (retired lane accepted, or dispatchable lane rejected) fails loudly instead of passing silently.
actualTranscript: command catalog smoke passed: 337 commands (exit 0). lattice validate --story=B-3783 executed it as configured validate.commands[5] (command 6/52) with code=0; overall validate process exit 0.
outcomeDiff: No diff: expected and actual match. Pre-fix the smoke exited 1 with the lattice-review-channel AssertionError; post-fix it exits 0 and is reached by validate.
limitations: The reverse branch currently exercises only lattice-review-channel (the sole registry entry retired from dispatch); the guard is written generically (ACCEPTED_TYPES membership) so it covers any future retirement or addition without editing the smoke.
pitfalls: Do NOT 'fix' this by adding lattice-review-channel to the dispatch agentType enum: that un-retires a deliberately-retired agent (contradicting AGENT_DISPATCH_ACCEPTED_TYPES and resolveAgentDispatchType) and does not even make the smoke pass, since validateAgentDispatchRequest still throws 'retired'. The fix belongs in the smoke guard, not the command catalog.
